title: Longest Substring Without Repeating Characters
description: Given a string s, find the length of the longest substring without repeating characters.
constraints: s consists of English letters, digits, symbols and spaces.
hints: Use a sliding window. Maintain a window [left, right] with no duplicates.
Use a HashSet to track characters in the current window.

optimalSolution.approach: Sliding window with HashMap. Map stores char → last seen index. When duplicate found, move left pointer past the duplicate. Track maxLen = right - left + 1.
optimalSolution.spaceComplexity: O(min(m,n)) where m is character set size

followUpQuestions: What is the time complexity of your sliding window solution?
What if we want the actual substring, not just the length?
How does your solution handle Unicode characters?
interviewerNotes: Canonical sliding window problem. Key indicator of algorithm skill. Look for correct handling of left pointer update (must take max with current left, not just set to charIndex+1). Most common mistake is incorrect left pointer management.
